name: sprite_builder_docuspace_write
description: Write (create or overwrite) a file in a docuspace. encoding 'utf8' (default) or 'base64' (to upload binary files as text). Content-type is inferred from the extension. Max 5 MiB.

docuspace_id.description: The docuspace's id (UUID, from sprite_builder_create_docuspace / sprite_builder_list_docuspaces).

content.description: File contents (utf8 text, or base64 if encoding='base64').
